```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library("duckdb")
library("dplyr")
library("pacman")
pacman::p_load(stringr, tidyverse, gtsummary, ggplot2, GGally, vtable, grid, gridExtra, diffdf)
source("replace_chunk.R")
peter_file <- "C:/Users/samake/OneDrive - Oregon Health & Science University/AD and DS Project/csand_data.duckdb/csand_data.duckdb"
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(peter_file))

```


```{r}
### set up assessments
tbl_diag <- tbl(con,"visits_assessments") %>% 
  select(-starts_with("extract")) %>% 
  select(contains("gad"), visit_id ) %>% 
  collect
### set up demographics
tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id, csa_id, race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
### get name of assessments
diag_name<- data.frame(colnames(tbl_diag))
```

###demographics clean up
```{r}
# set up/ data cleaning from exp_diag
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age)) %>% 
  select(-c(ptid, csa_id, shape, shape_num))
```

### analyze 
```{r}
colSums(is.na(tbl_diag)) #most of these are empty
```
### take out na rows
```{r}
gad_diag <- tbl_diag %>% 
  filter_out(if_all(starts_with("gad"), is.na)) %>% 
  select(c(visit_id,gad_source, gad_total, gadanx, gadfear, gadirrit, gadnorelax, gadnostop, gadrestless, gadworr))
```

###check again
```{r}
colSums(is.na(gad_diag)) #most of these are empty
```

```{r}
lapply(gad_diag, unique)
```

### fill in gad_total
```{r}
gad_compute <- gad_diag%>% 
  mutate(across(-c(visit_id,gad_source), ~ as.numeric(.)))
```

```{r}
lapply(gad_compute, unique)
```

```{r}
gad_compute_total <- gad_compute %>% 
  mutate(gad_total = rowSums(across(c(gadanx, gadfear, gadirrit, gadnorelax, gadnostop, gadrestless, gadworr)),  na.rm = T),
    ) 

gad_compute_total <- gad_compute_total %>% 
  mutate(status = if_else(
      complete.cases(.),
      "Complete",
      "Incomplete"
    ))
```

### innerjoin rows 
```{r}
gad_table <-inner_join(gad_compute_total, demographics, by = "visit_id") 
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(gad_table)) #most of these are empty
```

### summary table
```{r}
no_id <- gad_table %>% 
  select(-c(visit_id,visit_date, num_diagnosis, diagnosis, new_id))
```

```{r}
table_1 <- tbl_summary(
  no_id,
  by = further_diag,
  type = list(where(is.numeric) ~ "continuous"),
  list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
  label = c(list(race = "Race"), 
            list(eth = "Ethnicity"), 
            list(age_group = "Age"), 
            list(gender = "Gender"), 
            list(medicaid = "Medicaid")),
  missing_text = "Missing Values") %>% 
  as_gt()

gt::gtsave(table_1, filename = "gad_demo.png")
```

```{r}
table_1
```


### figures
```{r}
gad_table %>% ggplot(aes(x = gad_total, fill = status )) +
  geom_bar(stat = "count")+
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(further_diag), scales = "free") 
```

```{r}
no_id %>% 
  sumtable(group = "status", group.test = T)
```
